sections.title: Habit and range
sections.text: Cryptocarya nova-anglica is an understorey tree endemic to New South Wales, Australia. It reaches about 20 m in cool temperate rainforest in the highlands, around 1,100–1,350 m.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The small cream to pinkish flowers are about 2 mm across; ripe fruits are black and 10–12 mm long. The plate matches the glossy upper leaf surfaces, paler undersides, sparse flowers and black fruits. No food use is listed in the flora consulted.
